_note: Machine-readable rosters for the NEXUS scenario runbooks in strategy/runbooks/. Consumed by the Agency Agents app to turn a runbook into a one-click team deploy: it reads the roster, maps each slug to a catalog agent, and installs the set. `agents[]` entries are SLUGS — the agent .md filename stem (the corpus id), e.g. engineering/engineering-frontend-developer.md -> "engineering-frontend-developer"; specialized/agents-orchestrator.md -> "agents-orchestrator" (note: the stem is NOT always division-prefixed, and display names are prefixed/drift — so rosters reference slugs, which are rename-proof and testable). `mode` is the NEXUS activation mode (Full | Sprint | Micro) that sizes the team; `roster` groups preserve the runbook's phase structure via `activation`. `doc` is the prose runbook the app renders. Keep this in sync with the markdown in strategy/runbooks/; every slug must resolve to a real agent file (scripts/check-runbooks.sh can guard this, mirroring check-divisions.sh). strategy/ holds orchestration doctrine, not installable agents — it is NOT a division (see divisions.json).

runbooks.title: Startup MVP Build
runbooks.summary: Idea to live product with real users, fast — without skipping QA.

runbooks.title: Enterprise Feature Development
runbooks.summary: Ship a major feature into an existing enterprise product with non-negotiable compliance, security, and quality gates, and multi-stakeholder alignment.

runbooks.title: Multi-Channel Marketing Campaign
runbooks.summary: Launch a coordinated, brand-consistent campaign across channels that drives measurable acquisition and engagement.

runbooks.title: Incident Response
runbooks.summary: Detection through post-mortem for a production incident — fast response without cutting corners.

runbooks.title: Mobile App Launch
runbooks.summary: Take a mobile app from validated concept to store-ready release on iOS and Android — with performance, accessibility, and store-optimization gates built in.

runbooks.title: Data Platform Foundation
runbooks.summary: Build a reliable, governed data platform — ingestion, lakehouse, transformation, and analytics-ready assets — without sacrificing observability or compliance.

runbooks.title: E-commerce Storefront Launch
runbooks.summary: Launch a conversion-focused storefront with payments, catalog, and content wired correctly — and with QA and brand consistency enforced before the first real order.

runbooks.title: AI Feature Integration
runbooks.summary: Ship an LLM-powered feature into an existing product with prompt governance, evaluation, fallback behavior, and cost controls — not just a demo.

runbooks.title: Accessibility Remediation Sprint
runbooks.summary: Audit, prioritize, and fix accessibility failures against WCAG 2.2 / Section 508 — with evidence, not just good intentions.

runbooks.title: Public API Platform Launch
runbooks.summary: Launch a public API with stable contracts, developer documentation, sandbox access, and the operational guardrails that keep it usable and safe.

runbooks.title: Digital Transformation Program
runbooks.summary: Modernize product, platform, and process across an established organization — sequencing discovery, delivery, and change management so the transformation ships instead of stalling in a deck.

runbooks.title: Zero-to-One Venture Build
runbooks.summary: Stand up a new business line or spin-out from inside an existing company — validate demand, build the product, and take it to market with real economics behind it.

runbooks.title: Legacy Platform Migration
runbooks.summary: Move a production monolith or aging platform onto a modern architecture with a zero-downtime cutover plan, data integrity guarantees, and rollback paths that are actually tested.

runbooks.title: Codebase Modernization Program
runbooks.summary: Modernize a live codebase in place — reproducible toolchain and containerized local runtime first, then native data-plane consolidation, then load reduction and caching, then service extraction. Zero downtime, frozen baselines, and no big-bang rewrite.

runbooks.title: Repository Modernization & Hardening
runbooks.summary: Turn a working repository into a governed, enforceable professional one — license, security policy, code of conduct, contribution path, templates, CODEOWNERS, hardened CI/CD, supply-chain controls, and branch protection each proven by a deliberately failing PR.

runbooks.title: Post-Merger Integration
runbooks.summary: Integrate systems, data, brands, and teams after an acquisition — keeping customers supported and compliance intact while the two organizations become one.

runbooks.title: Compliance Certification Program
runbooks.summary: Drive an organization to audit-ready for SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent — controls implemented in code, evidence collected continuously, and the narrative defensible on the first pass.

runbooks.title: Security Vulnerability Response
runbooks.summary: Triage, contain, remediate, and disclose a reported vulnerability — with risk sign-off and coordinated disclosure rather than a silent hotfix.

runbooks.title: One-Week Design Sprint
runbooks.summary: Compress a product question into five days: research, sketch, prototype, and test with real users — and leave with a validated decision, not a prototype nobody tested.

runbooks.title: Bug Triage & Defect Elimination
runbooks.summary: Drain a defect backlog with priorities and evidence, then lock every fix behind a test so it cannot silently return.

runbooks.title: Open-Source Maintainer Operations
runbooks.duration: 2-4 weeks to install, then a permanent weekly cadence
runbooks.summary: Install the operating cadence that keeps a governed repository alive after hardening: triage, review pathway, release train, contributor pipeline.

runbooks.title: Design System & UI Quality
runbooks.summary: Turn screens into a system: tokens, components, parity between design and code, and a finish gate that keeps new UI from drifting.

runbooks.title: SEO & AI Search Visibility
runbooks.summary: Become the cited source in both classic search and generated answers - with sampled evidence, not ranking claims.

runbooks.title: Paid Media Launch & Spend Governance
runbooks.summary: Design the account, prove consent and measurement before a dollar moves, then hold spend to a finance-signed target.

runbooks.title: Monthly Close & Financial Reporting
runbooks.duration: 5 days per close cycle, recurring monthly
runbooks.summary: Run the close as a repeatable cycle that refuses to sign off on a figure that cannot be traced to a reconciled source.

runbooks.title: Pricing & Monetization Review
runbooks.summary: Turn pricing from a guess into a decision with evidence, a customer migration path, and a billing change verified before anyone is charged.

runbooks.title: Contract & Legal Intake
runbooks.summary: Classify what arrives, extract the clauses that carry risk, and route a decision to a human with authority - never issue an opinion of its own.

runbooks.title: Developer Experience Platform
runbooks.summary: Remove every step between a developer and their first successful deploy, and prove it by timing a real person on a clean machine.

runbooks.title: Feature Discovery to Spec
runbooks.summary: Convert a request into a spec with acceptance criteria a test can run against, and an explicit list of what is not being built.

runbooks.title: Delivery Recovery
runbooks.summary: Diagnose the real constraint in a failing program, renegotiate scope with named owners, and restore a cadence where the reported state matches the actual state.

runbooks.title: Release Train
runbooks.summary: Turn releasing into a scheduled, boring, repeatable run: a go/no-go that can fail, notes generated from merged work, and a rollback actually exercised.

runbooks.title: Security Posture Review
runbooks.summary: Measure the exposure that exists, prove which controls actually work by observing them fail, and remediate in order of real exposure - inside a written authorization scope.

runbooks.title: Customer Support Operations
runbooks.summary: Install the operating system of a support function: triage, knowledge that deflects, measurement that cannot be gamed by closing faster, and a feedback loop into product work.

runbooks.title: Agentic Product Build
runbooks.summary: Build an agent product with the evaluation harness before the feature list: tools, retrieval, guardrails, cost ceilings, and a regression suite on every change.

runbooks.title: Sales Pipeline Engine
runbooks.summary: Build the revenue motion: a defined ICP, signal-based outbound with a documented legal basis, discovery that disqualifies fast, and a forecast reconciled against closed reality.

runbooks.title: Growth Experiment Loop
runbooks.duration: 5 agent-days across a 14+ day calendar window, recurring
runbooks.summary: Run one experiment at a time with a pre-registered hypothesis, a computed sample size, a stopping rule, and the decision recorded before the data is seen.

runbooks.title: GIS Program Launch
runbooks.summary: Deliver a spatial product whose coordinate reference, geometry and topology are verified before it is styled.

runbooks.title: Spatial App Launch
runbooks.summary: Ship a spatial product whose comfort, latency and interaction budgets are release gates, verified in a real space by someone who did not build it.

runbooks.title: Game Launch
runbooks.summary: Take a game to a store release with the content pipeline verified from a clean machine and certification treated as an input, not a surprise.

runbooks.title: Academic Research Program
runbooks.summary: Deliver research output that survives scrutiny: every claim traceable to a source that was read, every figure regenerable, every method decision frozen before the result.

runbooks.title: Clinical Evidence Review
runbooks.summary: Assemble a cited evidence brief, state the strength of what it found, and route every clinical judgement to a named clinician - never issue a recommendation.

runbooks.title: Toolchain Standardization
runbooks.summary: One pinned toolchain, one lockfile, one task graph that mirrors CI step for step, and one documented way in — so local and remote agree about what verified means.
